thread:
maria: starting the v2 swap during the quiet window tonight 02:00 UTC. plan is a very small canary (internal tenants) + quick health checkpoints. i'm posting the minimal playbook here.

deploy-bot: scheduled rollout job created: job_id=rb-2026-03-21-01, canary=5%, window=02:00-03:00 UTC. will post status updates. :rocket:

jia: can we confirm release notes update and client-impact blurb? want to call out header signal changes and fallback behavior.

sam: rollback criteria proposal: if error rate > 1% for 5m OR 95p latency > 600ms for 5m, abort and pin traffic back to v1. also surface token-cost delta > 20% for sustained 10m?

alex: agree on the error/latency. recommend adding probe check for streaming endpoints (max fragment drop). if probing fails 3 consecutive pings -> auto-fallback.

maria: good call. probe used will be `canary-prober-v2` with streaming + json-schema check. probe config: `interval=30s, failure_threshold=3, success_window=2`

ops-bot: note: infra autoscale warmup window set to 6m for the canary pool (GPU spin-up). keep an eye on queue length.

oliver: docs note: SDK 2.1.0 adds optional `x-redwood-version` header. we should call out that older SDKs will be silently routed to v1 unless customers opt-in. I'll add a short blurb to release notes.

jia: also add a migration FAQ: How clients opt-in, how to pin back, and where to find telemetry dashboards.

sam: one more: pinlist for tenants that MUST stay on v1 during canary. maria can you share the tenant list?

maria: pinned list (internal only): tenant_ids = ["int-alpha", "int-beta", "perf-net"]. will not include external paying tenants in first wave.

maria: deploy command i'll run (ops-approved):
```
deploybot start --job rb-2026-03-21-01 \
  --route /api/v2 \
  --canary 5 \
  --probe canary-prober-v2 \
  --fallback-policy auto-pin-on-failure
```

deploy-bot: starting canary now. creating canary pool and draining 5% of eligible traffic. will post telemetry snapshots every 2m.

alex: monitors to watch: canary_cpu, canary_95p_latency, canary_error_rate, kv-cache-hit, token_cost_delta. setting alerts: error_rate > 0.5% for 2m -> ops-eyes, >1% for 5m -> auto-fallback.

sam: double-checking rollback steps: 1) deploy-bot auto-pins route to v1; 2) run quick incident triage; 3) if false alarm, we can re-run canary after fixes. confirm owners.

maria: owners: maria (release lead), alex (sre), jia (docs/comms). sam on-call for rollback ops.

jia: i added release note snippet and FAQ draft to the docs PR. will ping once merged.

ops-bot: canary pool ready. snapshot will be available at https://console.redwood/inference/canary/rb-2026-03-21-01/snapshots

oliver: notify customers with older SDKs via email opt-in banner? product says: not for 5% internal canary, but prep copy is ready if we widen.

sam: small note: watch for auth TTL mismatch in edge proxies. saw a 1m skew in staging earlier—could cause 401s during rollout.

maria: thanks, sam. i'll increase probe tolerance for auth failures to ignore transient 401 spikes for the first 2m.

maria: first 10m telemetry: CPU + latency within expected bounds, token_cost_delta ~ +6%, no elevated errors. continuing to 30m check.

deploy-bot: snapshot @8276543270 uploaded.

alex: 20m check: 95p latency 420ms, error_rate 0.12%, kv-cache-hit stable. marking as green.

sam: ops-eyes cleared unless we see upward trend. ready to expand canary to 20% after 1h stable if no regressions.

maria: expanding to 20% internal after 1h stable. re-run command with `--canary 20`.

deploy-bot: expansion complete. canary now at 20% (internal tenants only). watch windows open for 2h. automations: auto-pin on failure enabled.

jia: updating release notes to say: v2 rollout started in quiet window, internal canary -> 20%, SDKs older than 2.1.0 remain on v1 by default.

maria: final check 2h: all green. rolling to public ramp next change window tomorrow 02:00 UTC. will post traffic schedule and opt-in guidance. thanks all. :thumbsup:
